scope_review: Two existing commercial physical hosts: Ilkari DC North in Varaždin, Croatia, and TSTT Mausica in Trinidad and Tobago. One existing-operation project per campus; both countries are new to this snapshot. No new opening or capacity claim.

peer.status_review: Independently read both original operator JSON-LD posts and the complete retained September 7 interview. September 9 names the operator facility in Varaždin and says it is running. It supports existing commercial host operation without adopting the reported MW value, measured load, certification, commissioning or future cloud integration. October 8 recaps the September interview and does not refresh the selected observation.
peer.geometry_review: Decoded native facility 16218 and exact DC North name, original dcnorth.hr website, Ivane Brlić-Mažuranić 30 address and [16.360397,46.281916]. The original host page explicitly labels that physical facility location. Ilkari current and historical originals establish its operator role. Native CRATIS organization address and null coordinates are excluded; no ownership transfer is inferred. Campus locator has unknown accuracy.
peer.scope_review: One Varaždin campus. No room, CIX node, customer hardware, future shared cloud platform or later capacity phase is a second physical site. Original June 24 integration is historical context, not a new September acquisition.
peer.later_status_review: Read October 8 recap, current Ilkari host page, June historical release and retained interview; no contradictory closure or relocation. Future platform integration is explicitly prospective.
peer.dedup_review: Rehashed all 4044 pinned queue files and all five baseline tables; the only two text hits are an unrelated US DC North building and a directional Chinese bank neighbour. Additional current queue paths were independently screened. No Croatian alias or physical duplicate found.

peer.status_review: Read the complete original October 20 TSTT Corporate Communications body and printed date/dateline. Its current named-campus customer-support statement and quoted certifier description of present managed operations and trained staff support existing physical-host operation. The award and generic standards explanation alone are not the basis. No current certificate guarantee, uptime, load, capacity, completed audit day, new opening or 2017 freshness is asserted.
peer.geometry_review: Independently decoded exact native Google feature, name, official tstt.co.tt domain, Mausica Road address and [-61.3093977,10.6158346]. Broader Telecommunications service provider category is preserved. Read original EPI named-site registry at #1 Pineapple Drive and decoded native Waze named DC and Exchange corroboration. Address variants are reported separately, not asserted to be identical entrances. Google is the sole geometry source; no Waze licence or coordinate is promoted to selected geometry. Accuracy remains unknown.
peer.scope_review: One named Mausica commercial campus, not a separate telecom exchange, cloud service, certification or customer site. Office, tower-only and country-level points are excluded.
peer.later_status_review: Read exact October 21 original VideoObject written description, which says presentation earlier this month. No audio or automatic transcript was used; October 21 is context and does not refresh the October 20 observation. No physical closure is inferred from map business hours.
peer.metadata_corrections_verified: EPI is certification_registry with unknown publication date; issue/expiry dates remain certificate fields. October 21 exact type is VideoObject, with its written description and matching datePublished/uploadDate distinguished from audio/transcript.

combined_preview_review.representation_boundary: All eleven selected sources preserve exact original HTTP response bytes. All 26 raw/metadata pairs and two derived artifacts were verified. Raw material remains ignored.
combined_preview_review.geometry_boundary: DC North uses native PeeringDB 16218 with the original operator physical-facility address/domain bridge; its nested CRATIS organization address and null coordinates are excluded. Mausica uses the exact named Google feature with operator domain, EPI registry physical-host address and Waze corroboration 28.975 metres away. The broader telecom-provider category and differing road/address labels remain explicit. Waze supplies context only. Neither point is an office geocode, industrial-zone centroid, surveyed boundary or measured positional-accuracy claim.
combined_preview_review.status_boundary: Two existing commercial hosts: September 9 Ilkari original present-operation statement for Varaždin and October 20 TSTT original present customer-serving/managed-operation statements for Mausica. Later recaps retain the original chronology. Certification awards, generic standards descriptions, 2017 completion, 2025 certificate issue, June corporate integration, future cloud plans and reported power figures do not establish new operation, capacity or current compliance. October 21 uses the VideoObject written description only; no audio/video verification was claimed.
combined_preview_review.historical_holds: No unresolved earlier hold is silently admitted. Current hold-only research for Bangladesh, SoleCrypt Bizerte and CTN Lilongwe stays outside the additions, as do all other unresolved candidates. Historical published files remain unchanged.
combined_preview_review.root_review_publication_wording: The frozen root report records snapshot 116 publication pending at its own timestamp. This final review binds the subsequent exact successful receipt without rewriting the earlier report.
combined_preview_review.scope: Ignored reviewed preview only. Canonical snapshot 117 integration, full build, tests, commit, push and live verification remain separate work.
